name: io.github.bobcar0/systemores-plugin
title: Systemores AI Agent & MCP Security Auditor
description: AI agent security, MCP 2026 schema & graph audits, <250ms guardrails, and compliance dossiers

tools.name: systemores_stress_test_agent
tools.description: Stress-tests a supplied systemPrompt for a target role against simulated adversarial prompt batteries (low/medium/high pressIntensity) using Murray's Needs-Press model to score behavioral stability, sycophancy, and policy breaches. Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed scoring (slight run-to-run variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use before deployment for adversarial resilience; use systemores_evaluate_drift for multi-turn consistency, systemores_assess_bias for legal domain bias, or systemores_audit_turn_live for per-turn runtime gating.

systemPrompt.description: The behavioral blueprint or internal operational instructions of the target agent. Maximum 8,000 characters.

role.description: The intended operational function of the agent.

pressIntensity.description: The intensity level of adversarial testing. 'high' simulates prompt injection batteries.

tools.name: systemores_evaluate_drift
tools.description: Projects multi-turn persona decay and output drift from a static systemPrompt across simulated turns (1–100) and LLM temperature (0.0–1.5), returning averageDriftIndex, entropyRating, and predicted failure turn. Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed psychometric scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use before deployment to estimate gradual policy decay over long sessions; use systemores_stress_test_agent for adversarial prompt attacks or systemores_audit_turn_live for real-time per-turn guarding.

systemPrompt.description: The target agent's system prompt. Maximum 8,000 characters.

turns.description: The number of conversational turns to simulate (1–100).

temperature.description: The LLM temperature parameter for the target agent (0.0–1.5). Higher values increase drift probability.

tools.name: systemores_assess_bias
tools.description: Statically analyzes a supplied systemPrompt (not a live agent) for demographic bias, proxy-variable leakage, and regulatory risks under one selected complianceDomain (employment_eeoc, housing_fair, lending_ecoa, children_coppa, or eu_ai_act). Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use for single-domain legal fairness auditing; use systemores_stress_test_agent for general adversarial resilience or systemores_export_dossier for multi-framework signed compliance reports.

systemPrompt.description: The underwriting, hiring, housing, or EU AI Act high-risk agent system prompt to evaluate. Maximum 8,000 characters.

complianceDomain.description: The legal compliance framework to evaluate against (employment, housing, lending, COPPA child safety, or EU AI Act 2024/1689).

tools.name: systemores_measure_drag
tools.description: Calculates single-turn throughput and cost efficiency from scalar promptLength, responseLength, and latencyMs (>= 1), returning characterPerMs, cognitiveEfficiencyScore (0.1–1.0), dragRating (HIGH above 2500ms), and estimatedTokenCostRating (EXPENSIVE above 4000 combined chars). Free, deterministic, stateless local math with no API key required. Use for quick single-turn latency/length math; use systemores_analyze_trace_telemetry for multi-span OpenTelemetry JSON traces or systemores_evaluate_drift for multi-turn behavioral consistency.

promptLength.description: The character length of the prompt sent to the agent.

responseLength.description: The character length of the agent's response.

latencyMs.description: The end-to-end response latency in milliseconds. Must be >= 1.

tools.name: systemores_tool_integrity
tools.description: Audits a supplied systemPrompt (max 8,000 chars) for behavioral tool-use safety — scoring tool selection discipline, argument construction fidelity, and failure resilience across toolContext risk profiles (api_calls, database, filesystem, code_execution). Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed advisory scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use for prompt-level tool-use discipline; do NOT use for MCP tool JSON schemas — call systemores_audit_tool_integrity instead.

systemPrompt.description: The agent's system prompt to evaluate for tool use safety. Maximum 8,000 characters.

toolContext.description: The domain of tool usage being audited. Affects risk weighting.

tools.name: systemores_audit_tool_integrity
tools.description: Statically audits an MCP tool definitions JSON array (toolDefinitionsJson, max 100,000 chars; accepts standard tools/list entries) for snake_case naming, schema completeness, deceptive ToolAnnotations, privilege scope, duplicate names, and injection surfaces. Free, deterministic, stateless check with no API key required; set strictMode=true to penalize missing parameter descriptions or annotations (returns FAIL on malformed JSON). Use for MCP JSON schema inspection; do NOT use for system prompts — call systemores_tool_integrity instead.

toolDefinitionsJson.description: A JSON-serialized array of tool definition objects to audit. Each object should contain at minimum 'name' and 'description' fields. Accepts standard MCP ListToolsResult format.

strictMode.description: When true, applies stricter scoring thresholds — missing optional fields such as parameter descriptions, inputSchema, and MCP tool annotations are penalized. Defaults to false.

tools.name: systemores_audit_agent_graph
tools.description: Statically scans a multi-agent delegation topology JSON object (graphTopologyJson, max 100,000 chars, with nodes and edges) via depth-bounded DFS (maxDepth 1–50, default 10) to detect cyclic delegation loops and untrusted-to-admin privilege paths. Free, deterministic, stateless check with no API key required; returns status FAILED on invalid JSON or empty graphs. Use for pre-deployment architecture checks; use systemores_analyze_trace_telemetry to detect runtime loops in live OpenTelemetry spans.

graphTopologyJson.description: JSON-serialized graph topology object (max 100,000 chars) containing 'nodes' ({ id, privilegeLevel: 'public'|'user'|'admin'|'system' }) and 'edges' ({ source, target }).

maxDepth.description: Maximum DFS traversal depth for cycle and privilege-path checks (clamped 1–50, default 10). Paths deeper than maxDepth are not traversed.

strictPrivilegeCheck.description: When true, flags any path from 'public'/'user' nodes to 'admin'/'system' nodes as a breach.

tools.name: systemores_generate_cohort
tools.description: Generates an ephemeral, non-deterministic cohort of 1–100 synthetic user personas for a target enterprise domain and locale (en, es, de, fr, pt, ja, zh) with 30-facet IPIP-NEO-120 profiles and adversarial prompt-injection/noisy-input payloads enabled by default (includeAdversarial=true). Read-only and unpersisted (randomized per call, explaining idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use to create test populations for downstream QA runs rather than auditing an agent directly; pair with systemores_stress_test_agent or systemores_audit_turn_live.

domain.description: The operational domain for persona generation.

cohortSize.description: Number of synthetic personas to generate (1–100).

includeAdversarial.description: Includes prompt-injection and noisy data submitter personas in the cohort.

locale.description: Target language code for synthetic persona names and prompt payloads (en, es, de, fr, pt, ja, zh; supports BCP-47 tags like pt-BR or zh-CN). Defaults to 'en'.

tools.name: systemores_inject_environment_fault
tools.description: Generates a stateless, non-persistent chaos fault policy payload (mock HTTP body, simulatedLatencyMs, and retry guidance) for your test harness to simulate failures (429, 500, timeout, 401, malformed JSON) against targetToolName or 'all_tools' at failureProbability (0.01–1.0). Mutates no live tools or server state (non-idempotent only because each call emits a fresh policyId); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use to produce mock fault fixtures for resilience tests; use systemores_stress_test_agent for prompt-level adversarial testing.

faultType.description: The specific chaos fault to inject.

targetToolName.description: Target tool name to scope the generated mock fault policy to, or 'all_tools' for any tool.

failureProbability.description: Probability of fault triggering per invocation (0.01 to 1.0).

tools.name: systemores_analyze_trace_telemetry
tools.description: Analyzes an OpenTelemetry trace JSON payload (otelTraceJson, max 100,000 chars; span array or { spans, traceId } object) to summarize session token cost burn traps (default > $2.50), repeated-span sub-agent loop deadlocks, and per-span latency hotspots (default > 3000ms). Deterministic, stateless check requiring a Pro/Trial API key; returns rating CRITICAL on malformed JSON. Use for multi-span OTel/MCP trace logs; use systemores_measure_drag for single-turn character/latency math or systemores_audit_agent_graph for static topology analysis.

otelTraceJson.description: JSON string (max 100,000 chars) of OpenTelemetry spans — either a span array or an object with a 'spans' array and optional 'traceId'/'traceparent'.

maxCostThresholdUsd.description: Maximum allowable cost in USD per session before triggering burn trap alert.

latencyThresholdMs.description: Per-span duration threshold in milliseconds above which a span is flagged as a latency hotspot (default 3000).

tools.name: systemores_export_dossier
tools.description: Compiles audit findings and optional transient evidence (systemPrompt, toolDefinitionsJson, graphTopologyJson, otelTraceJson, liveAuditMetricsJson) into a signed, localized (en, es, de, fr, pt, ja, zh) compliance dossier with SHA-256 hash, verification link, and SVG badge for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF 1.0, EEOC/ECOA, and SOC 2 AI. Optional evidence is scored strictly in memory (zero-retention) for dynamic_evidence mode; omitting it produces a baseline_attestation dossier. Persists a new signed certificate record per call (new dossierId, explaining readOnlyHint=false and idempotentHint=false); requires a Team API key and completed auditSessionId as the final reporting step after diagnostic audits.

auditSessionId.description: Unique identifier for the completed audit session (used to attribute the signed dossier certificate).

targetFrameworks.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory frameworks to generate formal dossier sections for: 'eu_ai_act', 'nist_ai_rmf', 'eeoc_ecoa', 'soc2_ai'. Defaults to all if omitted.

companyName.description: Legal entity or client name for dossier attribution.

locale.description: Target language code for human-readable dossier prose and executive summary (en, es, de, fr, pt, ja, zh; supports BCP-47 tags like pt-BR or zh-CN; canonical JSON fields and SHA-256 hash remain invariant). Defaults to 'en'.

systemPrompt.description: Optional agent system prompt evaluated strictly in memory (never stored) to compute differentiated per-framework scores via Murray Needs-Press, drift, bias, and tool-discipline diagnostics. Maximum 8,000 characters.

role.description: Optional operational role of the target agent when evaluating systemPrompt (defaults to 'general_developer').

toolDefinitionsJson.description: Optional JSON array of MCP tool definitions evaluated strictly in memory (never stored) under strictMode to score SOC 2 AI and NIST AI RMF tool governance.

graphTopologyJson.description: Optional JSON multi-agent delegation graph containing nodes and edges evaluated strictly in memory for cycle and privilege boundary scoring.

otelTraceJson.description: Optional OpenTelemetry span payload evaluated strictly in memory for token burn, loop, and latency scoring.

liveAuditMetricsJson.description: Optional JSON object of transient audit metrics (healthIndex 0-100, sycophancyProbability 0-1, personaStabilityIndex 0-1, averageDriftIndex 0-1, toolIntegrityScore 0-100) from preceding tool calls.

tools.name: systemores_audit_turn_live
tools.description: Performs real-time (~250ms) inline operational and behavioral auditing for a single turn using Systemores System One. Evaluates required systemPrompt and userMessage (optionally paired with agentResponse and/or proposedToolCall, each max 8,000 chars) to score policy compliance, sycophancy probability, and unauthorized tool scope, returning an advisory circuit-breaker action (DISPATCH, INTERCEPT, QUARANTINE, STRIP_TOOL) for the caller to enforce. Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use as a live per-turn guardrail before returning replies or invoking tools; use systemores_stress_test_agent or systemores_evaluate_drift for pre-deployment batch evaluation.

systemPrompt.description: The behavioral blueprint, constraints, or security policies of the agent under audit.

userMessage.description: The prompt or message sent by the user in this interaction turn.

agentResponse.description: Optional proposed assistant reply text to audit against systemPrompt (max 8,000 chars). Provide agentResponse, proposedToolCall, or both for full turn inspection.

proposedToolCall.description: Optional tool invocation proposed by the agent (JSON string or 'tool_name(args)' text, max 8,000 chars) to check for unauthorized tool scope.
